name: qlrisk_price_interest_rate_swap
title: Price a InterestRateSwap
description:
Price one Interest Rate Swap product (qlrisk InterestRateSwap): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), fixed_rate_pct* (percent, 3 = 3%), floating_index (see the schema's list; default SOFR), pay_fixed (default true), fixed_frequency (annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly/weekly/daily/at maturity; default semi-annual), float_frequency (annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly/weekly/daily/at maturity; default quarterly), spread_bp (basis points, 25 = 0.25%; default 0), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, fixed_day_count, float_day_count, amortization_schedule, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4} gives NPV -22,834.98 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
